concerns.quote: The deceased was riding his motor bike through Stangrah Farm near Whitbeck. This had been the scene of an earlier accident damage from which had removed a chevron warning sign. It was clear from photographs that the road surface was not in good condition and holes had been patched. Evidence also showed the road surface adhesion to be below standard.
The warning signage on the approach to the corner is inadequate
he had been made aware of a couple of incidents at the same location previously
concerns.hazard: vehicles travelling at unsafe speed on a bend

reports.title: Richard Littlewood: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: The chevron signs warning of the bends facing traffic in both directions have been replaced. This work was carried out in July 2023.
promises.summary: Replace chevron signs at A1033 bends

promises.quote: new signage has been installed to pre warn drivers of the bends
promises.summary: New signage installed to warn drivers of bends

concerns.quote: Evidence was heard that, on this particular stretch/bend of the A1033, there have been 3 incidents that have occurred within a short space of time
During evidence it was heard that signage and road markings have been discussed between the police and Highways that may make the road safer
concerns.hazard: lack of timely road markings and signage
